text:
Noah: Hey folks-- quick recs for lunch near Redwoods SF office (3rd & Howard)? craving something cheap + tasty.
Priya: If you want cheap and filling, head to The Empanada Spot on Howard. lunchtime lines but fast.
Jules: There's also a dumpling counter on 4th (Tiny Dumpling House) 
works well for takeout.
Noah: Any vegetarian options?
Priya: Vegetarian? check out Greenslice (pizza) or The Lotus Bowl on 3rd.
Jules: Also recall a Mediterranean place (Olive & Grain) with a big salad bar.
kitchen-bot: Daily special near 3rd & Howard: Lotus Bowl -- 10% off for Redwood staff today.
Noah: Nice! Does anyone have weekend dinner recs near Ferry Building? friends visiting.
Priya: Hog Island Oyster Co. is great for visitors, but pricey. For casual try The Slanted Door or Coqueta for tapas.
Jules: Scoma's is classic seafood right on the pier.
Noah: Thanks! last q: best late-night slice nearby?
Priya: Tony's Pizza on Folsom open till 2am.
Jules: If pizza isn't required, Late-Night Pho on Market is open late too.
Noah: You're all lifesavers. I'll compile these into a quick doc for new folks.
Priya: Please share!
